summary: Cardiol Therapeutics Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the TSX and Nasdaq, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, an updated Code of Conduct and Ethics adopted by the board. The filing, signed by CFO Christopher Waddick and dated September 14, 2026, contains no transaction, stake, price, premium, or advisory detail. It is an ordinary corporate-governance disclosure equivalent to a US Form 8-K item 5.05-style policy update, not a special situation. No deal terms, no risk-arb angle; no actionable event to trade.
